text_simplified: The text presents educational stories and wisdom regarding the rights of children upon their parents, with examples of dealing with children through justice and mercy. It highlights the importance of the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children upon moral values and caring for their feelings. It also points to the necessity of avoiding discrimination among children in treatment.

review_defects.why: The Arabic adjective 'تربوية' (educational) modifies both 'قصصًا' (stories) and 'حكمًا' (wisdom), but the English phrasing 'educational stories and wisdom' can be read as only the stories being educational, leaving the wisdom unqualified.
